description: Create a paced campaign that messages the next N un-reached members of a contact list on a schedule. The cursor follows the LIVE list — as members are added or removed, only current members get reached, and nobody is messaged twice per cycle. Multiple campaigns can run on the same or different lists concurrently. On exhaust, either stop or loop (start over after a cooldown).

batchSize.description: How many contacts to message per run (default: 20)

botId.description: Bot to send through when sendMode='bot'; its channel is used

channelId.description: WhatsApp channel to send from; falls back to the org default / first connected channel

listId.description: The contact list to run the campaign over

text.description: The message body sent to each contact in the batch

mode.description: Rotate in order (default) or pick randomly per run

ref.description: A Neuron Note ID; its content becomes the message, fetched live at each run

anyOf.description: AI-written message generated live at each run (BYOK-aware)

botId.description: Bot whose system prompt supplies business context

perContact.description: Generate a distinct message per recipient (slower, more tokens). Default false = one message for the whole batch

personaId.description: Persona whose voice the message is written in

prompt.description: Instruction for the message the AI should write

anyOf.description: Message fetched from your webhook at each run

perContact.description: Call once per recipient with the contact in the payload. Default false = one call per batch

url.description: POSTed { campaignId, listId, contact? }; returns { message } or a bare string

messageSource.description: How the message is resolved live at each batch run: 'static' (fixed), 'rotation' (cycle through several), 'ai' (AI-written), 'webhook' (from your service), or 'content' (a saved Neuron Note).

onExhaust.description: When the whole list has been reached: 'stop' (default) completes the campaign; 'loop' starts a new cycle after loopCooldownMs

everyMs.description: Milliseconds between runs, e.g. 86400000 for daily

endAt.description: ISO date; the campaign completes after this

timezone.description: IANA timezone the daily/weekly/monthly time is interpreted in, e.g. 'Africa/Lagos'. Defaults to UTC. Ignored for 'interval'. The schedule holds its local wall-clock time across DST.

schedule.description: When each batch fires. e.g. daily at 9am in Africa/Lagos, or every weekend.

sendMode.description: 'message' sends a plain broadcast; 'bot' initiates the conversation through a bot (default: 'message')

startImmediately.description: Fire the first batch right away (default: true). Set false to wait for the first scheduled slot

name: neuron_create_list_campaign
title: Create List Campaign
